verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's pricing docs confirm a drag-and-drop email editor and basic email templates, available even on the free plan. Personalization is described only at a marketing level ('real-time data and AI to power personalization'), with no documentation of merge tags or tokens. missing for 10: documented personalization tokens/merge-tag syntax, evidence of cross-client rendering/preview testing, brand-kit or on-brand styling controls, reusable saved-template/universal-block details, independent hands-on corroboration of the editor.
